visualCharacteristics.purpose: rows of cells laid out side by side from 900px, stacked on mobile with image-only cells first
visualCharacteristics.description: featured: image takes two thirds from 900px with the text in a grey panel beside it; the paragraph above the heading is the label. spec: single-column list of trip facts, each item with a 5px #ebebeb left border, 18px left padding and 22.5px gap; label 12px uppercase #696969, value 14px weight 600 uppercase #202020.

contentPattern.structure: each cell of a row becomes a column. featured: one row, image | label paragraph, h2 title, description, bold CTA link. spec: rows of label | value (plain text) rendered as a definition list; missing values give an empty dd, extra cells merge into the value, empty rows are dropped

usage: Side-by-side content; featured article teaser on the magazine page; trip facts (Activity, Adventure Type, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price) on adventure detail pages.
reuseGuidance: Use Columns (Featured) for an image + grey text panel teaser. Use Columns (Spec) for label/value fact lists. Use plain columns for generic side-by-side content.
